unusable_named_checkpoint.note: The pinned repository has no model weights. Train the teacher from the pinned Qwen3 checkpoint instead.

partition.semantic_policy: globally order token-5 shingles by document frequency and index at least |S|-ceil(0.85*|S|)+1 per record so every pair with Jaccard >= 0.85 shares an indexed shingle unless an explicit bucket cap is hit; cluster only pairs with Jaccard >= 0.95 and identical ordered numeric tokens; retain >= 0.85 candidates in the audit ledger; fail scientific preparation if any blocking bucket is skipped
partition.primary_collision_policy: quarantine every train cluster spanning M and O; quarantine every train cluster touching M test

objective_contract.teacher_stage: GRPO with verifiable math task reward
objective_contract.student_main_arm: task reward plus a clipped positive-gap-gated K1-value score-function reverse-KL surrogate; only the ungated unclipped on-policy limit is K4/r-trick gradient-equivalent
objective_contract.student_primary_baseline: task reward with identical student rollouts and update budget
objective_contract.token_alignment: exact token IDs plus a pinned tokenizer fingerprint and live server probe; same-family names alone are insufficient
objective_contract.primary_budget: matched unique examples and optimizer steps; prompt and completion tokens are measured rather than assumed equal across sources
objective_contract.teacher_gap_semantics: teacher_skill_dev is held out from the teacher's training source; target_gap_dev is held out from the student rollout source and is reported separately
